mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_change_history (api_id, user_id, name, method, url, headers, query_parameters, form_parameters, file, selected_body_type, saved_at) VALUES (#{apiId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{method}, #{url}, #{headers}, #{queryParameters}, #{formParameters}, #{file}, #{selectedBodyType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, api_id AS apiId, user_id AS userId, name, method, url, headers, query_parameters AS queryParameters, form_parameters AS formParameters, file, selected_body_type AS selectedBodyType, saved_at AS savedAt FROM api_change_history ORDER BY saved_at DESC

SELECT id, api_id AS apiId, user_id AS userId, name, method, url, headers, query_parameters AS queryParameters, form_parameters AS formParameters, file, selected_body_type AS selectedBodyType, saved_at AS savedAt FROM api_change_history WHERE api_id = #{apiId} ORDER BY saved_at DESC

SELECT id, api_id AS apiId, user_id AS userId, name, method, url, headers, query_parameters AS queryParameters, form_parameters AS formParameters, file, selected_body_type AS selectedBodyType, saved_at AS savedAt FROM api_change_history WHERE api_id = #{apiId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY saved_at DESC LIMIT #{recentCount}
SELECT DISTINCT user_id AS userId FROM api_change_history
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM api_change_history WHERE saved_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
